title: Fix three bugs in an existing semver library
summary: SWE-style: reproduce three user-reported issues in a library, fix root causes, add regression tests.
description: An existing library for semantic versions and npm-style ranges with three bug reports: prerelease precedence, hashing/equality of build metadata, and caret ranges for 0.0.x. Fix the root causes without breaking existing tests, add regression tests and a changelog entry.
